---
title: "Programmable Nanopore Fabrication"
subtitle: "Instrumentation and automation"
---

This work concerns controlled dielectric breakdown, electrolyte-assisted pore fabrication, electrical measurements, and automation of experimental procedures.

## Research question

How can electrical fabrication methods be organized into repeatable experimental workflows?

## Approach

The work connects pore formation, electrical characterization, and experimental data acquisition.

## Research scope

The engineering focus is on measurement control and workflow automation. Detailed hardware designs and fabrication protocols will be added following public-release review.
